findings.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
findings.description: Net Net-(J1-Pin_1) has 27% reference plane coverage over 17.2mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. On a 2-layer board the gaps are usually where back-side tracks cut the pour into islands — stitch the two pours together (draw-pcb stitch_zones) so return current has a way across. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J4
findings.description: Connector J4 (DC OUT 2) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J4. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: Via stitching may be insufficient
findings.description: Board has 1 vias across 4500 mm² (no vias detected). For the highest frequency on this board (150 MHz), λ/20 stitching requires ≤48mm spacing.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias at ≤48mm intervals, especially at board edges and near connectors.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (90×50mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 794 MHz; (0,1) at 1429 MHz; (2,0) at 1588 MHz; (1,1) at 1635 MHz; (2,1) at 2136 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

coverage_matrix.note: Design rule checks identify common radiation sources. Cannot predict absolute emission levels.
Switching harmonic analysis and decoupling checks. EMI filter verification not yet implemented.
